LESSON: -DIMENSIONAL CONSTRUCTION

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify materials for 4 Lessons
2. create forms in 3-d using locally found materials for innovation
3. handling construction materials for exploration and enjoyment
4. appreciate self and others work create the 3D items, keenly observing personal safety. others work place Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify materials for 4 Lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify materials for 4 Lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. create forms in 3-d using locally found materials for innovation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create forms in 3-d using locally found materials for innovation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. handling construction materials for exploration and enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to handling construction materials for exploration and enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate self and others work create the 3D items, keenly observing personal safety. others work place Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate self and others work create the 3D items, keenly observing personal safety. others work place Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION.
2. Explain -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION.
4. Show that you can: identify materials for 4 Lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is -Dimensional CONSTRUCTION important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify materials for 4 Lessons
2. create forms in 3-d using locally found materials for innovation
3. handling construction materials for exploration and enjoyment
4. appreciate self and others work create the 3D items, keenly observing personal safety. others work place Core-Competence

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
